standardization: None: raw deconvolved activity; no baseline subtraction, division, or additional feature scaling
eligibility: At least 10 atlas-assigned neurons with finite required frames; no baseline variance exclusion
lda: Ledoit-Wolf analytic shrinkage of pooled training within-class residual covariance toward trace(S)/N times identity; estimated independently per neuron subset, training context, fold and frame; class-frequency priors; no feature scaling; numerical pseudoinverse for zero covariance
inference: Equal mouse weighting after session averaging; 5000 shared mouse-bootstrap weights
embedding: Training-only within-area alignment; descriptive cross-area registration and group-mean PCA
prediction_ties: Smallest class index within 1e-10 * max(1, max absolute score) of the maximum score

lda_shrinkage.residuals: Training trials minus their training class mean, pooled across classes
lda_shrinkage.scope: Separate per neuron subset, training fold, task/context and training frame
